summary.text: Christoph Dundas is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 23B, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A public school band teacher in Austin, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities are rural healthcare, education, and housing and cost of living.

paragraphs.text: Dundas said in a Ballotpedia survey that he grew up in Wells in a single-income family with five younger siblings and worked part-time jobs in foodservice, hog farms and construction.
He attended United South Central High School and St. Olaf College, and he has taught band in Austin public schools since 2016.
According to the survey, he was named the 2025 Austin Teacher of the Year and a 2025 Minnesota Teacher of the Year finalist.
Dundas lives with his wife, Kelsey, and their four children, and said his family relied on state healthcare during his oldest daughter's premature birth and later cancer treatment.
He said Minnesota must act to protect rural clinics and hospitals, guarantee a minimum level of funding for the smallest schools, and invest in affordable rental housing and entry-level homes.
